headline: Daily research brief — Sunday, November 15

items.title: Nvidia reports Tue Nov 17 after close — the only watchlist earnings in the window, with a 9.6% move implied
items.detail: Nvidia is the only watchlist name reporting in the next two weeks, Tue Nov 17 after close, with consensus of $2.49 EPS and about $109 billion in revenue. Options imply a move of about 9.6% (Nov 20 weekly straddle; about 8.6% on the cleaner Nov 18 straddle), about 2.1 times the 4.53% average absolute earnings-day move over the last four quarters. Correction to yesterday's package: the signed average of those four moves is +0.23%, not -0.02% as printed Nov 14 — two up, two down, no directional bias either way. Premium into a binary event is to be avoided.

items.title: Hormuz escalated over the weekend; crude has not repriced yet — Monday's open is the test
items.detail: Iran's Revolutionary Guard claims a supertanker sank after a mine strike on Sun Nov 15 — SPECULATION, with no vessel name, flag, or imagery and no independent confirmation. UKMTO Warning 205-26 confirms a tanker was attacked in the Arabian Gulf before entering the Strait, crew safe, but gives no cause and does not link the attack to the mine claim. The Houthis' fourth Riyadh attack in six days was intercepted early Sunday. Friday's crude close was flat (WTI $88.56, Brent $95.84) and traffic through the Strait remains about 65% below pre-war levels — the market is pricing no confirmed disruption, not recovered volumes.

items.title: Rates: Desk 7 unchanged — 25bp hike call for Dec 9, 10-year at 5.10%
items.detail: FRED as of Nov 12 (the Nov 13 observation has still not posted): the effective federal funds rate is 3.88%, the 2-year Treasury 4.86%, and the 10-year 5.10%, putting the 2s10s slope at +24 basis points, flat on the week. The call is unchanged: a 25 basis point hike on Dec 9, 5 HIKE / 1 CUT / 4 NEUTRAL across the ten core indicators, with Kalshi pricing total hike at $0.99 (was $1.00). Five more hawkish speaker remarks Thu-Fri bring the weekly count to 12 hawkish / 0 dovish. At assumed perpetual growth of 3.00%, the Gordon multiple falls to 47.62x from 50.51x, down 5.72%; re-anchor the discount rate to 5.10%.

items.title: Every IV-versus-realized verdict is window-contingent — no clean premium call on any name
items.detail: The Nov 5 crash day still drives 37-54% of each name's 20-day realized variance, above the 30% threshold, so no clean cheap-or-rich premium verdict is supportable on any name today. Implied vol sits below trailing realized vol on all six names, but that gap is inflated by the crash day in realized. Nvidia's 103.43% at-the-money implied vol on the Nov 18 expiry is an earnings hump (+42.8 points over Nov 16), not rich premium. The IV null streak is broken — the Nov 14 inputs file has populated at-the-money IVs — but the window un-contaminates only after about Dec 3. IV rank is UNVERIFIED for all six names: no free IV-history source is available.

desks.Dividends: Microsoft goes ex-dividend Thu Nov 19 at $0.98 per quarter, the first payment at the raised rate (+7.7%) and its 24th consecutive annual increase, payable Dec 10. Apple's $0.27 payment lands Mon Nov 16, but its ex-date (Nov 12) is already past. Nvidia has not yet declared its next ex-date; on pattern the declaration would appear with its Nov 17 earnings release. SPY and QQQ December ex-dates are unconfirmed. Tesla pays no dividend.
desks.Earnings: Nvidia is the only watchlist name reporting in the next two weeks, Tue Nov 17 after close, with consensus of $2.49 EPS and about $109 billion in revenue. Options imply a move of about 9.6% (Nov 20 weekly straddle; about 8.6% on the Nov 18 straddle), against a 4.53% average absolute earnings-day move over the last four quarters. The signed average of those four moves is +0.23% (corrected from -0.02% yesterday) — no directional bias. Premium into a binary event is to be avoided.
desks.Futures: Hormuz escalated over the weekend: Iran's Revolutionary Guard claims a supertanker sank after a mine strike (unconfirmed, SPECULATION); UKMTO Warning 205-26 confirms a tanker was attacked in the Arabian Gulf, crew safe, cause unstated; the Houthis' fourth Riyadh attack in six days was intercepted. Friday crude was flat (WTI $88.56, Brent $95.84), down about 2.5% for a second straight week as the IEA called a fourth-quarter surplus and OPEC+ output rose 2.04 million barrels per day in October. Natural gas rose 7.7% on the week on a real cold snap; soybeans gained 37.75 cents on fresh USDA export sales to China. Next: EIA petroleum report Wed Nov 18, OPEC+ meeting Nov 29.
desks.Parity: No parity violation was found. Saxo Options Briefs for Nov 5, 6, and 11 show put-call parity on the Nov 18 VIX options holding within a few cents of settlement. Cboe's SPXO, AM-settled SPX weeklies, has its first expiry Wed Nov 18 (last trading day Tue Nov 17) — the structural watch item for any future SPX box or conversion construction. No current SPX box-spread rate could be verified from free sources today, so none is quoted.
desks.Premium: All six verdicts are WINDOW-CONTINGENT. The Nov 5 crash day still drives 37-54% of each 20-day realized-variance window, above the 30% threshold, so no clean cheap-or-rich premium verdict is supportable on any name today. Nvidia is the standout: at-the-money implied vol of 103.43% on the Nov 18 expiry, up from 60.61% on the Nov 16 expiry, because Nov 17 earnings sits inside the Nov 18 expiry. That is the event being priced, and premium into it is to be avoided. The IV null streak is broken — the Nov 14 inputs file has populated at-the-money IVs. IV rank is UNVERIFIED for all six names: no free IV-history source is available.
